decision_cruda.rationale: N600-08 is stopped, so LH-05 is free. I'm activating RS-N522-03 (9.5 g/t, 412 t) with it. It is 0.37 h away and Norte's stockpile is empty with spare truck capacity. Loading starts about 10:52 and lunch takes 0.5 h, so about 5.6 h of loading at 38.5 t/h gives roughly 217 t, or about 66 oz. RS-E543-02 has a similar yield (about 73 oz), but Este is already truck-limited and its stockpile would approach capacity. No loans are made, and nothing is down.
